UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated customer profile storing mobile number registration.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

mobileNumber.description: 10-digit mobile number entered by the customer.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: A grain/product saved to the user's personal watchlist (મારી યાદી).

grainId.description: ID of the grain item in /grains.

addedAt.description: Server timestamp when added to watchlist.

GrainItem.title: GrainItem
GrainItem.description: Grain or grocery product with live price, weight, and stock managed by Admin.

name.description: Product name in Gujarati or English.

category.description: Product category (e.g., અનાજ, કઠોળ, દાળ, કરીયાણું).

pricePerKg.description: Current price per unit in INR.

priceUnit.description: Unit for pricing (e.g., Kg, 20 Kg, લિટર).

imageBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG thumbnail encoded as Base64.

updatedBy.description: UID of admin who last created or updated the item.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last price/weight/stock update.

LoginLog.title: LoginLog
LoginLog.description: Audit record of customer or admin app logins visible to Admin.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the logged-in user.

loginRole.description: Whether login was customer or admin.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Verified admin registration record linked to authorized Mahadev Traders numbers.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified admin.

StoreConfig.title: StoreConfig
StoreConfig.description: App download URL and QR poster headline managed by Admin.

downloadUrl.description: Play Store or APK download URL encoded in the QR code.

headline.description: Headline displayed on the QR download poster.

updatedBy.description: UID of admin who last updated the QR download link.

/users/{userId}.description: Customer profile records isolated to owner and admin.

/grains/{grainId}.description: Live grain and grocery price catalog managed by admin and synced to customers.

/loginLogs/{logId}.description: Customer and admin login records viewable by admin.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Verified admin records authorizing catalog edits and login log reads.

/storeConfig/{configId}.description: Store app download link and QR poster settings.
